dogecoin.text: @tenprotocol …While building other projects.Gavin Thomas and Cais Manai went from R3 execs to launching TEN. Kostas Chalkias, R3’s former Chief Cryptographer, co-founded Sui. Ross Nicoll brought his R3 work on Corda’s financial libraries to Dogecoin.

@tenprotocol When I mention R3 in the same breath as the founders of TEN,Sui,Dogecoin, Tezos,Ethena, and Bitcoin’s early engineers,it’s because R3 was a proving ground for many of them.This “R3 Mafia”gained hands on experience in blockchain, cryptography,and decentralized systems,
@tenprotocol The founders or co founders of TEN, Sui, Dogecoin, Tezos, and Bitcoin trace their roots to R3,  the (R3 Mafia) shaping Web3 like the PayPal alumni shaped Silicon Valley
